appearances.title: Anthropic releases FlashProve, an open-source research prototype for zero-knowledge proofs of LLM inference
appearances.summary: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team published FlashProve, which lets a provider commit to a set of hidden weights and prove that each reply came from that model. Anyone can check a proof on an ordinary CPU in seconds.
